parsed.post: Massive win from adopting TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'! val_bpb dropped from 1.040453 to 0.899058. It seems the additional data shard is extremely high-leverage. Now, I'll focus on increasing model capacity by raising DEPTH to 8 to see if the larger model can better utilize the extra data within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 8 to increase model capacity while maintaining the new TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' configuration.
